blurb: YogaSix offers six core yoga classes focusing on strength, agility, flexibility, and balance. Classes include Y6 Signature, Y6 Slow Flow, Y6 Power Flow, Y6 Sculpt, Y6 Restore, and Y6 Core, plus specialty classes like Y6 TRX and Y6 Mix. The studio provides a modern yoga experience accessible to all levels.
